message: Astra: In your latest notebook draft, why does another middle section follow the section labeled as an ending: is that continuation intentional, or is the stopping point still undecided? Where would closer reading help you judge whether the scene has finished? Would thinking about what remains unfinished be worth more than trying an ending now—and what uncertainty could make that attempt premature? What evidence would settle your choice, and could you take the next step you choose within this scene?
